# ElvUI Progressive DataBars

The default DataBars (XP, Honor, Azerite, Reputation) in [ElvUI](https://tukui.org/elvui) are visually simple –– this plugin enhances them with dynamic opacity based on progress. This plugin should work with all other ElvUI plugins, but if it doesn't, file a bug report via the link below.

## Supported WoW Versions

- Classic, which includes Classic Era, hardcore, fresh, and seasons
- The Burning Crusade Classic
- Titan Reforged, a Wrath of the Lich King Classic version exclusive to China
- Mists of Pandaria Classic
- Retail (currently Midnight)
- Forever

## The XP DataBar

- Blend the alpha/opacity of the bar as you gain XP
- Blend the alpha/opacity of quest XP based on pending quest rewards
- Supported by all WoW versions

## The Reputation DataBar and Tooltip

- Blend the alpha/opacity of the bar as you gain reputation
- Pre-defined colours which you can change in ElvUI's main settings > DataBars and main settings > Tooltip
- Optionally fills capped Exalted, friendship, and Renown bars; Paragon continues to show progress toward its next reward
- Fills the reputation bar at Hated until you start gaining reputation
- Friendship factions (Mists & Retail) are adjusted based on the number of ranks the faction has, meaning some may display higher than Hated colour to start and cap at Exalted colour

## The Game's Reputation Pane

- Apply the reputation DataBar's colours, fill settings, progress blending, and smoothing to each faction's bar in the game's reputation pane
- Uses the same friendship rank mapping and supports Paragon and Renown where available
- Enable it during installation after the Tooltip step, or under Coloured DataBars > Miscellaneous > Reputation
- Text and icons stay fully opaque for readability
- Disabling the feature restores the pane's normal appearance

## The Honor DataBar

- Retail only
- Blend the alpha/opacity of the bar as you gain Honor

## The Azerite Power DataBar

- Retail only
- Blend the alpha/opacity of the bar as you gain Azerite Power
- Hidden if you do not have an active Artifact or Azerite item

## Localization

You can help [contribute translations](https://legacy.curseforge.com/wow/addons/elvui-progressive-databars-colors/localization) so other people around the world of Azeroth can have this glorious AddOn in their native tongues.

## Bugs or Suggestions

Did you find something that isn't working, or thought of an improvement? By all means please [let me know](https://github.com/Myrroddin/elvui_progressive_databars_colours/issues).

## Credits

Credit is due to Blazeflack on the TukUI forums who graciously helped me get going with writing a plugin for ElvUI, and to Torhal on Curseforge who helped me work through some tricky logic. Thank you guys!

## Cookies & Treats

I accept cookies, treats, donations, and game time. If you'd like to support me:
